NBA DFS Picks for Friday, November 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Friday, November 6 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 6, 6:44 PM ET

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is the top-projected player on the Friday, November 6 DraftKings main slate at 51.7 DraftKings points for $10,200. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 48.3, $10,000) and Cooper Flagg (DAL, 48.0, $9,900) are next.

Deandre Ayton (WAS) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.84 projected points per $1,000 at $3,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 6, 6:44 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
